chapter: Germany, Buck's death and ideas about life
title: Buck dies while he is abroad
summary: Five years in Germany trying to build a base for Buck and Bubbles, he learned of Buck's death by a card from his wife; Buck had been planning to work with Timmy Rogers.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Now remember, Buck passed away while I was there. I'm there five years now, I had to stay five years to get back -- five years it took me to get back. You understand? Look how long I stayed there to get back here. All the time I was trying to build up the thing for Buck and Bubbles over there. If I could get on the ground floor over there, I could get Buck over there and we could start out from over there, because we are a good act, you know. But he died before I could get back here. And I got a card that he passed from my wife who said, "Buck passed and his wife wouldn't tell her where this or where that or nothing, and man, I cried when I got that card. Did I cry! Oh, dear! It hurt me to think I just come

over there for those 10 days and I was going to try to make up a foundation over there for Buck and Bubbles and send him his fare to come on over there instead of trying to break out on that low-paying salary trying to get Buck and Bubbles on in America. And I'd start over there for nothing. I'd be better off, that was my thought. You know?
